name: ringee
description: Operate Ringee — outbound calling, contacts, leads, call sessions, callbacks and meetings — directly from Claude, backed by the Ringee MCP. Enforces confirmation for sensitive (credits, magic links) and destructive (delete, revoke) actions.

mcp_url.title: Ringee MCP URL
mcp_url.description: Your Ringee MCP SSE URL from the dashboard (Settings → MCP / Integrations, i.e. GET /api/mcp/connection-info). Example: https://api.ringee.io/api/mcp/<userId>/sse (or .../<userId>/<organizationId>/sse).
